notes: Modified cash basis city audit (FYE 9/30/2022). Governmental lines from the Total Governmental Funds column (p5-6); fund balances roll forward (4,129,310 + 2,648,115 - 3,157,318 + 620,000 + 363,811 - 130,658 = 4,473,260). Cash and fund balance are separate: ending_cash = cash lines of the governmental funds Balance Sheet (p4), beginning_cash from its 2021 Totals column; certificates of deposit in the investment fields; fund balances also include LB 840 loans receivable and CDs, so the cash change does not equal the fund-balance change. Business-type lines from the modified cash proprietary statement (p8-9), which ties to the Statement of Activities (p2: expenditures 6,291,977, charges for services 4,202,459); the accrual-basis proprietary statement (p10-11, report pp44-45) is supplementary and not used; the Statement of Cash Flows (p12-13) is not recorded (non-GAAP report; as FY2023/FY2024). Internal service fund (net position 158,382) is in governmental activities only on the government-wide statements; its transfers in 76,593 explain the gap between governmental fund transfers (net 233,153) and business-type transfers (-309,746). Sewer Bond proceeds 3,270,516 are printed under nonoperating revenues, so a business-type receipt line; the Debt Service Fund Bond/loan proceeds 620,000 are under Other Financing Sources on p6, so debt_proceeds. Statement 'Public works' 386,108 = Street Fund 356,427 + General Fund cemetery 29,681 (budget schedule p15 lists Cemetery under Public works; categorized streets/highways). Detail: General Fund from the combining schedule by sub-fund (p14; more detailed than the General Fund budget schedule p15-16, which is not recorded); Street and Debt Service Funds from their budget schedules (p17-18; Street 'Charges for services' budget 1,000 and 'Capital outlay' budget 82,000 have no actual, not recorded); Sales Tax, Economic Development, Keno and utility funds (Light, Water, Sewer, Landfill) have no own schedule, so no statement-column detail lines (as FY2023/FY2024). The All Funds budget schedule (p19-20) is combined and not recorded. Component unit (St. Paul Development Corporation, p21) excluded. Grants: General 206,456, Police 500, Library 4,392, grantor not stated. Read pages 1-21 of 21.
